resolutions.researcher_notes: VALUE CHANGE PROPOSED — GEM currently carries StartYear1=2009 / StartMonth1=12 and NOTHING readable supports it. Three independent origins agree on 2010: nea.gov.cn '自2010年3月29日建成投产'; chinanews/Xinhua 2010-03-29 announcing '建成投产' the same day; 中国石化新闻网 via china5e and 澎湃 (thepaper 1578871) both '2010年8月31日正式投入商业化运行' (commercial operation, reported also by 中国证券报). So the trunk has two documented milestones — commissioning 2010-03-29 and commercial operation 2010-08-31 — and GEM's Dec-2009 date matches neither. The likely provenance of 2009-12 is the 2009-12-03 '主干线全线贯通' (mechanical completion / line-fill) milestone, which appears only in a search snippet of dazhou.gov.cn/news-show-29861.html; that page timed out twice over both http and https, WebFetch returned 404, and it has no Wayback capture, so it is an ACCESS FAILURE and not citable — the milestone stays unsourced. One dissenting attestation to weigh: 新华网 via people.com.cn (2019) says '管道自2009年投运以来', supporting the YEAR 2009 but no month, and contradicted by the same agency's own 2010 dispatch. ORCHESTRATOR DECISION: adopt 2010/3 (commissioning) with 2010/8 optionally recorded as StartYear2/StartYear2Month for commercial operation, or keep 2009 with a ResearcherNotes caveat. Sinopec's own v2 disclosure (Jan-2009 claim) is 404 with no snapshot.

resolutions.researcher_notes: No live document states 1628.64 km. That figure came from the trqi.sinopec.com disclosure, which is a confirmed 404 with NO Wayback capture and no relocated copy (searched the bare string "1628.64" with 川气东送/干线/公里; searched sinopec.com listco pages, pipechina.com.cn, mee.gov.cn EIA approvals) — so it is unrecoverable rather than blocked, and I will not stage a ref that does not carry the number. What the live record says about trunk length, all read: 1635 km 干线 as-built ('管道总长2170公里，其中干线全长1635公里', 中国证券报 via chinanews, 2010-09-01, the best-attested as-built trunk figure); 1674 km in the 2006 route plan (中国证券报 via sohu, 2006-08-25); '干线长度1700公里' in the 2007 pre-construction framing on ce.cn; 1,702 km on en.wikipedia (system-level, undocumented methodology); 2170 km = trunk + 3 branches, a SYSTEM figure that must never be pasted into this segment cell (aggregate-vs-segment). ORCHESTRATOR DECISION: either keep 1628.64 as a route-geometry-derived value with a ResearcherNotes caveat that no public document states it, or adopt 1635 km with the chinanews/中国证券报 ref (a 6.4 km / 0.4% change). I did not stage the 1635 ref onto the 1628.64 value because the numbers disagree — no orphan refs in either direction.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Single origin, and only partially supporting: the 2006 approved-route report (中国证券报 via sohu) states the trunk as '普光－安徽省宣城段管径采用1016mm，安徽省宣城－上海段管径采用864mm' — so 1016 mm is the western two-thirds and 864 mm the Xuancheng–Shanghai eastern section. resolutions.researcher_notes: Relevance re-read RESOLVED: china5e DOES name the row ('川气东送管道' throughout, and the article is titled 川气东送管道累计输气量突破1000亿方), so v2's name_found:false was a fuzzy false negative. The 15.00 bcm/y value is post-upgrade capacity: '川气东送管道增压工程一期工程全部完成，设计年输气能力提升至150亿立方米'. SECOND SOURCE STILL OWED and honestly not found: every other origin read gives the ORIGINAL design capacity of 120亿立方米/年 (nea.gov.cn 2013 '设计年输净化天然气120亿立方米'; chinanews/Xinhua 2010; 中国证券报 2010; 澎湃 2016 '年输送天然气120亿立方米'; en.wikipedia 12 bcm/y) — those corroborate the 12 bcm/y baseline, not the 15. The only other 150亿 statement found is the same china5e article's forward-looking note that 增压工程二期 will take the line to 170亿立方米/年. Searched for a second 150亿 origin in pipechina.com.cn news, nea.gov.cn 2021-2025 items, 央广网/央视 2025 coverage (that piece is about 川气东送二线, +30亿立方米/年, a different row) — none. Tier medium, single origin (Sinopec news service via china5e); the 12-vs-15 split is a real distinction (original design vs post-2020 compression), not a conflict to average.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Existence, identity and classification CONFIRMED, with three aggregate-vs-segment cautions for the merge. (1) The row is real and correctly scoped as the 川气东送一线 national trunk: the NDRC tariff table lists it as one pipeline with named branches (达化专线、川维支线、南京支线、江西支线、武石化支线、西一线联络线), and nea.gov.cn/chinanews describe '输气管道主干线和三条支线'. (2) NOT a duplicate of P4661 (川气东送二线 皖赣支干线) — the second line is a separate 4269 km system from 四川泸县 to 浙江温州, under construction since 2023-09-16, nor of P4649 (川气东送江西支线), which is one of this trunk's branches and appears as such in the NDRC table. (3) THREE system-level figures must not be pasted into this row's segment cells: 管道总长2170公里 is trunk+3 branches (the trunk is 1635 km); 总投资626.76亿元 covers Puguang gas-field development + the acid-gas purification plant + the pipeline (see the SegmentCost record, left blank); and the 260亿立方米/年 system capacity quoted in 2025 coverage belongs to the 川气东送 SYSTEM after the second line, not to this row. No deletion or reclassification is recommended.
